pure_helper:
def alt_format_too_many_configs(alt_format: bool, n_config_files: int) -> bool:
    """Mirror of Tensile/Tensile.py:526 predicate `altFormat and len(configPaths) > 2`.

    Returns True when the alternate-format branch's printExit fires
    (alt format selected AND more than 2 config files supplied).
    """
    return alt_format and n_config_files > 2

Real-runtime caveat (does NOT change the predicate truth table, only which domain points are reachable): ConfigFile uses nargs='+', so argparse guarantees len(configPaths) >= 1. The seed allows configPaths=0 but argv can never produce it. The TRUE-witness (altFormat=True, configPaths=3) and reachable FALSE-witnesses (altFormat=False configPaths=3, or altFormat=True configPaths=1) are all argv-realizable.
Short-circuit: Python and evaluates len(configPaths)>2 only when altFormat is truthy; the truth table above already reflects the short-circuit (no observable difference for these total inputs).
Branch body fires printExit('Only 1 or 2 config_files are accepted for the alternate config format...') when the predicate is True.
